nusmp.skill.jibril.description: The Archangel of Law. Four passives (Divine Rigor, Heavenly Presence, Strict Governance, Wings of Revelation), five edicts (Absolute Command, Judgment of Heaven, Heavenly Purge, Holy Shackles, Word of Law) and, once mastered, Kingdom of God: a held sanctuary of fifty blocks where allies cannot fall below 1 HP and enemies are stripped of their blessings and crushed by gravity. Since 3.23.0 the judgments smite: Judgment of Heaven hits the unholy (the undead, demons, creatures in Temporal Debt) half as hard again, Heavenly Purge burns the unholy near you, the Holy Shackles bite for every good effect they take, and the Kingdom of God wears its enemies down every second.
nusmp.skill.jibril.mastered: Jibril is mastered: Kingdom of God answers you, the edicts cost less and cool down faster, Divine Rigor shelters your allies, and the parry of Word of Law lasts longer.
